.github/workflows/validation-gate.yml.content:
name: validation-gate

# AGENTS.md, "Validation gate" (owner rule, 2026-10-19): no row reaches the IC
# leaderboard or benchmarks/README.md without a replay certificate, a validator
# report and a matched rho reference, named by the VALIDATION.json of its
# evidence directory (docs/VALIDATION_GATE.md).  Rows that predate the gate are
# frozen in docs/ic/validation/PRE_GATE.json and benchmarks/PRE_GATE.json and
# render as "unvalidated (pre-gate)"; a row added or changed after the freeze
# must be validated, and the freeze files may only shrink.
#
# This runs on every pull request (no paths filter): the check is cheap, and a
# filter would let a row slip in through a file the filter forgot.

# Store data the gate reads through VALIDATION.json (session records named as
# raw_data, replay inputs) and that this file never names: tools/artifacts/
# wire_workflows.py pulls these declared paths with the ones it finds.
# tools/artifacts pull: benchmarks/20261029-ic-aimed-gather/registry-binding-20261123
# tools/artifacts pull: benchmarks/20261115-fes-k13-runpod/session experiments/31_solve_cost
# tools/artifacts pull: experiments/37_solver_b_pivot_count
# tools/artifacts pull: research/blindspots_20261018/01-fp2-gaudry-k2/raw
# tools/artifacts pull: research/cheon_ecbench_20261022/sessions
# tools/artifacts pull: research/cheon_ecbench_wide_20261106/sessions
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ecbench_generator_orbit_20261022/sessions
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ecbench_overhead_review_20261022/sessions
# tools/artifacts pull: research/fes_k13_validated_20261112/runpod-a1/session
# tools/artifacts pull: research/five_leads_e2e_20261019/sessions_projective_chart_v2.tar.zst
# tools/artifacts pull: research/four_followups_20261021/results/matched
# tools/artifacts pull: research/four_followups_20261021/results/pencil-pilot
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ic_aimed_gather_20261023/aa2_20261029/runs
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ic_packed_filter_20261029
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ic_gw_bl_reuse_20261115
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ic_gw_nrm_lz_20261115
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ic_tableb_binary_ksum_20261115
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ic_ksum_prune_20261115
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ic_tableb_ksum_20261115/sessions
# tools/artifacts pull: research/icb_large_prime_n53_n61_20261029/sessions
# tools/artifacts pull: research/kummer_coordinates_20261022/results
# tools/artifacts pull: research/kummer_differential_collector_20261022/results
# tools/artifacts pull: research/ml_cryptanalysis_pt_lgrow_k1_20261114
# tools/artifacts pull: research/pencil_sparse_20261022/results
# tools/artifacts pull: research/pkm_tower_rootfind_20261018/sessions
# tools/artifacts pull: research/projective_law_followup_20261022/results
# tools/artifacts pull: research/wallfix_runpod_20261114/sessions/run2

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      local_runner:
        description: Use the dedicated local validation runner
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.workflow_ref || format('run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  gate:
    # Keep the merge gate available while the optional EKS pools are offline.
    # This is ordinary CPU validation; experiment runner selection is separate.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      # The full-history checkout no longer fits a hosted runner: from
      # 2026-10-23 04:20 UTC every run died with "No space left on device".
      # The gate reads the head's working tree and, through `git show`, two
      # files on the base tip, so it needs no history. Free the preinstalled
      # SDKs it does not use, check out only the head, and fetch only the
      # base tip; its blobs arrive on demand.
      - name: Free runner disk
        if: runner.environment == 'github-hosted'
        run: |
          df -h /
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/android /usr/share/dotnet /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/.ghcup /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          df -h /
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
      - name: Pull store data this workflow reads (tools/artifacts)
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ARTIFACTS_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.ARTIFACTS_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_REGION: ${{ vars.ARTIFACTS_AWS_REGION || 'us-west-2' }}
        run: |
          if ! command -v aws >/dev/null; then
            python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/artifacts-awscli"
            artifacts_cli_python="$RUNNER_TEMP/artifacts-awscli/bin/python"
            artifacts_cli_aws="$RUNNER_TEMP/artifacts-awscli/bin/aws"
            if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/artifacts-awscli/Scripts" ]; then
              artifacts_cli_python="$RUNNER_TEMP/artifacts-awscli/Scripts/python.exe"
              artifacts_cli_aws="$RUNNER_TEMP/artifacts-awscli/Scripts/aws.exe"
            fi
            "$artifacts_cli_python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check awscli==1.46.2
            export ARTIFACTS_AWS="$artifacts_cli_aws"
          fi
          python3 tools/artifacts/artifacts.py pull --jobs 16 benchmarks/20261115-fes-k13-runpod/session experiments/31_solve_cost experiments/37_solver_b_pivot_count       - name: Fetch the base tip
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.local_runner)
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref || 'main' }}
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 --filter=blob:none origin \
            "+refs/heads/$BASE_REF:refs/remotes/origin/$BASE_REF"
          # validation_gate.py refuses a base ref that does not resolve; check
          # it here too so the failure names the fetch.
          git rev-parse --verify "origin/$BASE_REF^{commit}"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        # EKS runners may default to Python 3.12; the dedicated local runner
        # already includes 3.11 and keeps its isolated tool cache untouched.
        if: runner.environment == 'github-hosted' || !startsWith(runner.name, 'crypto-cli-gate-')
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Restore tracked benchmark inputs for committed-tree tests
        run: |
          git restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- \
            research/postgb_linear_stage_20261026 \
            research/ic_m2_linear_ladder_20261024 \
            research/s5_plain_c4_options_20261019 \
            benchmarks/20261029-ic-aimed-gather/registry-binding-20261030 \
            benchmarks/20261029-ic-aimed-gather/registry-binding-20261101 \
            benchmarks/20261029-ic-aimed-gather/registry-binding-20261105
      - name: Historical aimed-gather numeric custody controls
        run: python3 benchmarks/20261029-ic-aimed-gather/registry-binding-20261123/test_numeric_fidelity.py
      - name: The gate's own tests, with a positive and a negative fixture
        run: python3 scripts/test_validation_gate.py
      - name: Reject stale native curve catalog bindings
        run: |
          python3 scripts/test_curve_catalog_consistency.py
          python3 scripts/check_curve_catalog_consistency.py
      - name: Every leaderboard and benchmarks row is validated or frozen pre-gate
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.local_runner && 'main') || '' }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$BASE_REF" ]; then
            python3 scripts/validation_gate.py check --base "origin/$BASE_REF"
          else
            python3 scripts/validation_gate.py check
          fi

.github/workflows/large-files.yml.content:
name: large-files
# AGENTS.md §13: a file over 10 MiB goes through `crypto store push`, not Git,
# because every blob committed stays in every future clone. This fails a pull
# request that adds or modifies one (scripts/check-large-files.sh). A PR that
# must commit one anyway carries the `large-file-ok` label, which the owner or
# a reviewer adds; the check then reports the files and passes. It runs no
# experiment.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled, ready_for_review]
# A newer push to the same pull request cancels this workflow's run for the older commit.
# Every other event (push, schedule, dispatch) gets a group of its own and is never cancelled.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.workflow_ref || format('run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  size:
    if: ${{ (!github.event.pull_request.draft && (github.event_name == 'pull_request')) && (github.event_name == 'pull_request') }}
    # Keep the merge gate available while the optional EKS pools are offline.
    # This is ordinary CPU validation; experiment runner selection is separate.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Free runner disk before checking the full PR tree
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/android /usr/share/dotnet /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/.ghcup /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
      # Materialize the head's blobs once; sizing thousands of lazy blobs in a
      # sparse checkout exceeded the 25-minute PR job budget.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          filter: blob:none
      - name: No added or modified file over 10 MiB
        env:
          LARGE_FILE_OK: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'large-file-ok') }}
        run: |
          if scripts/check-large-files.sh HEAD^1 HEAD; then exit 0; fi
          if [ "$LARGE_FILE_OK" = true ]; then
            echo "::warning::large files committed under the large-file-ok label"
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1

.github/workflows/artifacts.yml.content:
name: artifacts
# docs/artifacts.md: data files live in the artifact store (S3), with a
# .artifacts.json manifest in Git. This runs the tool's tests, fails a pull
# request that adds or modifies a tracked file the policy says belongs in the
# store, and checks that every workflow naming moved data pulls it. A PR that
# must commit such a file anyway carries the `large-file-ok` label, which the
# owner or a reviewer adds; the check then reports the files and passes. It
# runs no experiment and touches no remote.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled, ready_for_review]
# A newer push to the same pull request cancels this workflow's run for the older commit.
# Every other event (push, schedule, dispatch) gets a group of its own and is never cancelled.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.workflow_ref || format('run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  artifacts:
    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.draft }}
    # Keep the merge gate available while the optional EKS pools are offline.
    # This is ordinary CPU validation; experiment runner selection is separate.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: ci
      GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: ci@example.invalid
      GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: ci
      GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: ci@example.invalid
    steps:
      - name: Free runner disk before checking the full PR tree
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/android /usr/share/dotnet /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/.ghcup /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
      # Materialize the head's blobs once; sizing thousands of lazy blobs in a
      # sparse checkout exceeded the 25-minute PR job budget.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          filter: blob:none
      - name: Tool tests
        run: python3 -m unittest tools/artifacts/test_artifacts.py
      - name: Blobless prefetch regressions (local Git only)
        run: python3 -B .github/scripts/test_artifact_prefetch.py -v
      - name: No added or modified file that belongs in the store
        env:
          LARGE_FILE_OK: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'large-file-ok') }}
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != pull_request ]; then exit 0; fi
          if python3 tools/artifacts/artifacts.py check HEAD^1 HEAD; then exit 0; fi
          if [ "$LARGE_FILE_OK" = true ]; then
            echo "::warning::data files committed under the large-file-ok label"
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
      - name: Workflows that read moved data pull it
        run: python3 tools/artifacts/wire_workflows.py --check
